openQuestions.q: CHK-003 context says score-selfcheck.mjs uses fixture-generator.mjs to generate a corpus in a temp root, but fixture-generator.mjs is an M1 deliverable. The story description and checklist do not address whether fixture-generator.mjs is expected to already exist (from a prior story) or must be created within B-d217. If it does not yet exist, the CHK-003 selfcheck cannot run. Is fixture-generator.mjs a pre-existing artifact (from M1 preceding this M4 story) or does it need to be created as part of B-d217?
openQuestions.evidence: CHK-003 context: "(a) generate a corpus with fixture-generator.mjs into a temp root"; M4 milestone in section 13 lists reuses: "adjudicate.mjs outcome state machine; checks.mjs; packages/lab scoring core; ground-truth.mjs pattern" — fixture-generator.mjs is NOT listed as reused and is not listed as a new deliverable either. M1 exit criteria (section 13): "Generator emits deterministic fixtures with oracle labels; per-trap answer-source strip list documented."
